outputs.explanation: Flow cytometry scatter/pseudocolor plots showing individual cell events with gates; not a bar chart of averages, so overlay of individual points is not applicable (scatter plots are exempt).
Flow cytometry scatter plots displaying individual cell events directly; exempt as a scatter-type plot.
Flow cytometry scatter plots of gated cell populations; each dot is an individual cell event, exempt from the check.
Color-coded overlay scatter plots of individual cell events across populations (MBC, GC, naive); exempt as scatter-type plot, not an average summary chart.
Flow cytometry gating scatter plots showing individual cell events; exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
